decisive_items: RT-PCR test of sputum: Positive for SARS-CoV-2
Haziness in both lower lung fields with infiltrations in around 10% of both lungs, consistent with atypical viral pneumonia
response.rationale: Direct evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection and radiographic findings consistent with viral pneumonia support COVID-19 pneumonia over other options

rejected.why: Lack of antibody response is noted, but vaccine-induced immune suppression is less directly supported by the vignette than COVID-19 pneumonia
